catalog.subtitle: QC, readability, timing, and batch summary modules live here.

format-qc.label: Format QC
format-qc.summary: Validate ordering, overlaps, gaps, and container-level subtitle integrity.

readability-density.label: Readability
readability-density.summary: Track cue density, line pressure, and reading comfort across the selection.

cue-timing-structure.label: Cue timing
cue-timing-structure.summary: Inspect cue durations, pacing windows, and structure consistency.

lexical-frequency.label: Lexical frequency
lexical-frequency.summary: Surface repeated terms, channel vocabulary, and basic text distribution.

batch-summary.label: Batch summary
batch-summary.summary: Roll active-entry metrics into a compact batch-level overview.

logical-consistency-check.label: Logical consistency
logical-consistency-check.summary: Check subtitle statements for coarse logic slips, implausible transitions, and cue-level reasoning gaps.

contradiction-detection.label: Contradiction detection
contradiction-detection.summary: Flag conflicting claims, polarity flips, and inconsistent assertions across the active selection.

narrative-drift.label: Narrative drift
narrative-drift.summary: Track whether topic focus drifts sharply across files or sequential subtitle blocks.

repetition-structure.label: Repetition structure
repetition-structure.summary: Surface repeated phrases, slogan loops, and over-compressed vocabulary patterns.

semantic-coherence.label: Semantic coherence
semantic-coherence.summary: Estimate whether subtitle density, cadence, and term reuse still form a coherent narrative flow.

archive-to-ai-payload.label: Archive to AI payload
archive-to-ai-payload.summary: Export a compact analysis payload tuned for downstream AI review and replay prompts.

channel-batch-analysis.label: Channel batch analysis
channel-batch-analysis.summary: Summarize multi-file subtitle archives as a single channel-level narrative bundle.

entities-keyphrases.label: Entities and keyphrases
entities-keyphrases.summary: Planned entity and glossary extraction for people, brands, and recurring terms.

semantic-search.label: Semantic search
semantic-search.summary: Planned embedding-backed lookup for quote finding and related cue discovery.

native-subtitle-qc.label: Native subtitle QC
native-subtitle-qc.summary: Runs built-in subtitle validation and summary analyzers inside the room.

subtitle-archive-export.label: Subtitle archive export
subtitle-archive-export.summary: Packages subtitle archives into AI-ready payloads and batch-level exports inside the room.

planned-entity-provider.label: Planned entity provider
planned-entity-provider.summary: Reserved provider slot for entity, glossary, and keyphrase extraction.

planned-semantic-provider.label: Planned semantic provider
planned-semantic-provider.summary: Reserved provider slot for semantic search and similarity workflows.
